notes.title: Update 0.162.0
notes.content:
[h3]Small Addition[/h3]

Hi all, this small update adds a toggle option in the options menu to stop items from falling off the sides of the lift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506196/de4b84d8947509677781e76f1613e5ddf95ee24f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.161.2
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Hi all, this patch fixes the space bugs spawning in a frozen state and falling to the floor but can still attack and be attacked by the player.

This issue with the space bugs should now be fixed:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506196/42c92e8229f4b5c466aeb7e6310c2058a71c8a56.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.161.1
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Hi all, this patch will hopefully fix the pistol not spawning bug that has been reported by several players.

I have tested this on the Mac Demo and Early Access versions. I do not have a Windows machine so your feedback will be helpful on whether this fix has resolved the issues for Windows users.

Thanks,
GrumpyDragon

notes.title: Update 0.161.0
notes.content:
[h3]New Content & Changes:[/h3]

[b]New Weapons/Pick Ups[/b]
[list]
[*] New [b]Explosive Mine[/b] pick up that explodes when triggered by space bugs.
[*] New [b]Jump Pad[/b] pick up that launches the marine into the air.
[/list]

[b]New Power Ups[/b]

[list]
[*] New [b]Explosive Mine Explosion Range Power Up[/b]. Increase the explosion range when the mine is triggered.
[*] New [b]Explosive Mine Trigger Range Power Up[/b]. Increase the trigger range for the explosive mine.
[*] New [b]Jump Pad Jump Force Power Up[/b]. Increase the launch force when using a jump pad.
[*] New [b]Jump Pad Charges Power Up[/b]. Increase the number of uses of the jump pad.
[*] New [b]HP Heal Amount Power Up[/b]. Increase how much healing is done when collecting HP.
[*] New [b]HP Drop Rate Power Up[/b]. Increase the drop rate of HP.
[/list]

The new pick ups and power ups have also been added to the stats information.

[h3]Demo Version[/h3]
The demo version update contains:
[list]
[*] New [b]HP Drop Rate Power Up[/b]. Increase the drop rate of HP.
[/list]
